committee.sub: Morning brief · Thursday 24 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Ad spend fell to $135.11 from $185.58 and clicks to 23 from 29, with conversions still at zero. postRestartClicksSince8Sept sits at 57, well short of the 150-click stop-loss threshold.
budgetLost30d (22.6%) remains below rankLost30d (72.3%), so the budget conversation stays closed. CTR actually improved to 4.6% from 3.5% even as impressions dropped to 495 from 824.

Homepage and /ai-automation-agency.html each drew 22 sessions, but /simpro-xero-integration.html pulled 81 impressions in search and converted only 2 clicks at position 17, a message-match gap worth noting on that page.

AI Assistant sessions rose to 2 from 0 over the last 7 days, all via chatgpt.com. This channel undercounts since many AI referrals land as Direct with no referrer. Organic Search also grew to 12 sessions from 7, with google/organic up to 11 from 4.

actions.text: Logo and image assets plus keyword-matched RSA headlines for the currently serving ad groups are still outstanding.
The homepage form confirm-then-count fix remains open: kontrolTrackLead should fire on the Formspree verdict, not before it.
RSA description D1 still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week; update it to match the current site stats.
